learned_val.null: Train-fit smoothed jump chain + empirical state dwell; distribution-preserving, not exact transition counts; empirical training dwells include boundary-censored runs and final simulated dwell is censored at original length
learned_val.statistic: Equal-series sum of heldout RLE-jump log2 p_train(next|previous two)/p_train(next|previous one), divided by original nonoverlapping windows minus first two per sequence; fixed exposure across nulls
learned_val.bootstrap: Complete-series resampling; vocabulary/null fixed; Monte Carlo null uncertainty not included in CI
learned_val.motif_statistic: Equal-series RLE motif counts per original-window n-gram opportunity; fixed exposure across nulls
learned_val.motif_family: All training-selected length2-4 motifs for this frozen vocabulary/heldout split, BH; exploratory cross-analysis pooling required for additional families
